name: Cross-Structure Collaboration Module
definition: A module integrating multi-scale tri-plane features with context-aware grid features to generate Hierarchical Dense Embedded (HDE) features, preserving global coherence and local detail.
summary: The Cross-Structure Collaboration Module integrates global tri-plane features with local context grids to generate hierarchical dense features, solving misalignment in large-scale 3D Gaussian Splatting.
